label: J1-07-a
setup: Build rs5CDbKv / git3c0cd57. Original QA-origin save backed up to .cache/pre-resume-storage-07.json. Normal UI Start a new summer, masculine Rowe, textured undercut/open overshirt/cuffed chinos/loafers; Low preset selected through settings. Natural clock at1x, no freeze. No game-state or position fixture writes. Short walks may use declared synthetic keys with scripted camera steering. Blender authoring may run concurrently; this is not a performance benchmark.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

method.input: Observed DOM keydown/keyup, pointerdown/up, wheel, and UI clicks; isTrusted retained.
method.limitations: One-second snapshots miss intermediate motion. DOM isTrusted is recorded, not a claim of human input. Memory is JS heap and renderer counts, not process/GPU bytes. No intervention detection beyond logged events and caller disclosures.

hud.speaker: Study the valley route chart
hud.words: Iona has marked the safe valley route in ochre. Lantern Road leads south to Haven. North of Aldermere, pass through the Mosswood Gate and keep to the riverbank trail. At Silverveil, the walking path climbs the western switchbacks; the water itself is not a shortcut. Starroot lies beyond the falls. The high bridge leads toward Crownreach. Leave the bicycle at the lower lookout before the steep walking trail.

hud.words: The rim is held square while Oren checks each spoke against a wooden gauge. One pale replacement spoke is still untrimmed.
